text:
Jules: Heads up — two promos this week! Leo and Priya both moved up 🎉🎉 Quick idea: 3:30pm mini celebration in the kitchen? I can bring a sourdough loaf I accidentally perfected this morning 😅

Anika: WHAT?? That's amazing, congrats both!! :tada: Count me in for 3:30. Also need cake details.

Rae: congrats!! :confetti_ball: I'll bring streamers.

Leo: thanks y'all!! low-key still in shock. pizza or cake?

Priya: omg thank you!! I vote cake but also down for whatever. also bringing tiny party hats. :partyparrot:

Jules: Poll: react with :cake: for cake, :croissant: for pastries, :bagel: for bagels — or just come hungry.

Maya: can't make the conga line but will drop off cupcakes at 3pm. congrats again ❤️

DevBot: Reminder: Kitchen occupancy limit is 8 people. Please be mindful of hot coffee and the blender.

Anika: lol DevBot, you're such a mood. also++ to sourdough recipe pls Jules.

Jules: recipe will be posted in #recipes after the chaos. also if anyone wants to roast the sourdough, I accept gentle ribbing. :bread:

Rae: someone start the conga playlist. I nominate 80s pop.

Priya: 80s pop it is. See you at 3:30!
